## What and why

<!-- What does this change, and why? Link the issue it closes: "Closes #123". -->

## Type of change

<!-- Match the commit prefix (the PR title should use it too: release-please builds the changelog from it). -->

- [ ] `feat:` new command, setting or scene template
- [ ] `fix:` / `perf:` CLI bug fix or speed-up
- [ ] `brand:` house style (`brand/`, `templates/`)
- [ ] `docs:` documentation
- [ ] `deps:` dependency or HyperFrames version bump
- [ ] `refactor:` / `test:` / `ci:` / `chore:` no user-visible change

## Checklist

- [ ] `uv run ruff check .` and `uv run pytest` pass (tests added or updated for any CLI change)
- [ ] `AGENTS.md` and `docs/` updated if commands, settings or the script format changed
- [ ] No episode content, music beds, org assets or licensed fonts (DINPro) added: those belong in the private `sep-episodes` workspace or are gitignored
- [ ] No API keys, `.env` or personal paths committed
- [ ] Version and `CHANGELOG.md` not hand-edited (release-please owns them)

## Rendering and brand changes

<!-- Only for changes to brand/, templates/, or render/timing code. Delete otherwise. -->

- [ ] `uv run studio check demo-paris-commune` passes
- [ ] Compared a draft render or `npx hyperframes snapshot` frames before and after (attach screenshots)
- [ ] `demo-paris-commune/timing.json` regenerated by `sync` if timing maths changed
